_comment: Provenance for the recognizer content ported from Presidio into
Presidio is MIT-licensed and, since 2026, community-owned under the
data-privacy-stack organisation. We vendor its CONTENT (patterns, context
word lists, checksum algorithms) rather than depending on the package:
presidio-analyzer hard-depends on spaCy, and the guard pod runs at 2451Mi
of a 4Gi limit with a 2.5GB GLiNER model already resident.
Vendoring means upstream fixes do not arrive on their own. This file plus
`python -m tools.check_presidio_drift` makes that a visible decision rather
than a silent one: each entry records the exact upstream blob we read, so
the checker can report which have changed since.
Blob SHAs, not a version pin, so the check needs no install and no spaCy.

ported.took: pattern (position-specific letter alphabets, never-issued prefixes), context words
ported.notes: Compiled uppercase-only rather than IGNORECASE, matching every other country pattern here; a lowercase NINO is not a form anyone writes and the case-blind version costs precision on ordinary words.

Made ANCHOR-REQUIRED, which upstream is not. Measured: the checksum admits 9.2% of random ten-digit runs and the 3-3-4 grouping is also a NANP phone number and a spaced-IBAN tail. Anchor words extended with Dutch (polisnummer, verzekeringsnummer, zorgverzekeraar) because the document language is not the identifier's country.

Only the current (2001+) format. Upstream also ships prefix (1983-2001) and suffix (1963-1983) formats at confidence 0.2 and 0.15; both reduce to 'a letter, up to three digits, three letters', which is too common in ordinary text for our precision bar. The age-identifier range check is folded into the pattern rather than kept as a separate validator.
The DVLA check-digit algorithm is not public, so upstream's validate_result only rejects; ours does the same. Not a checksum.
Reuses the existing passport anchor alternation, which already carries both Dutch and English wording.

evaluated_and_rejected.reason: Upstream ships it at confidence 0.1. A postcode is not a standalone identifier, and the only category it could map to here is Address — a fuzzy GLiNER category whose spans are whole address blocks, so emitting 'SW1A 1AA' as an Address would make the span extent lie about what was found. Same call as DE_PLZ, which upstream itself flags as high-false-positive at confidence 0.05.
